🔻 Iran will take all necessary measures to break US blockade: Deputy FM

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran considers the US economic blockade imposed on the country an act of war and will take all necessary measures to break it, Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi said on Saturday, stressing that such restrictions are unacceptable to the Islamic Republic.

Speaking to reporters, Gharibabadi stressed that Iran would not accept economic pressure as a means of imposing political demands, reiterating that the country would respond to the blockade through appropriate measures.
​
The deputy foreign minister said Tehran remained in contact with mediators, including Qatar, to examine whether diplomacy could be given another chance. These contacts were taking place through both in-person meetings and virtual exchanges, he added.
​
Gharibabadi confirmed that a Qatari delegation visited Tehran the previous night, holding approximately two hours of discussions before returning. He expressed appreciation for Qatar’s diplomatic efforts and its role in facilitating communications between the parties.
​
He also said Iran’s two-day proposal, previously presented by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to the Sultan of Oman, remained on the table as Tehran’s only formally submitted plan.
​
Gharibabadi said progress in the diplomatic process would depend on Washington meeting the requirements necessary for implementing the proposal, adding that Iran was prepared to move forward once those conditions were fulfilled.
​
He further stressed that Tehran would act in accordance with its commitments whenever Washington fulfilled its own obligations.
​
